correctness.rationale: For each finite cycle, the no-adjacent-ones rule makes every 00 bond a sign-preserving wall and fixes its count parity to cycle parity. Exact circular gap enumeration gives the count polynomial. A uniform factorial majorant establishes convergence of the normalized count distribution; parity-restricted multivariate Riemann sums prove independent uniform limiting positions conditional on each fixed count, and tightness permits mixing. The exact two-point sign product reduces correlations to arc-count parity, calculated using Poisson independent increments conditioned on total parity. Boundary sectors n even k=0 and n odd k=1 and normalizations were checked. Standalone verify.py produced 297 checks using exact finite enumeration and transfer-matrix calculations. Finite checks corroborate, do not prove, infinite assertions.

value.rationale: Near maximal occupation on a one-dimensional ring, thermal defects control the failure of alternating crystalline order; odd cycles retain an unavoidable frustration wall. The n-squared high-activity window is the unique scale at which a finite positive number of macroscopic walls remains. A full parity-projected spatial point process characterizes their geometry and determines continuum-scale two-point correlations, including a topological even/odd distinction. This is an intrinsically motivated equilibrium finite-size scaling observable, stronger than restating the known partition polynomial.
